clips.title: The story
paras: Terenthis watches the corruption spreading through Darkshore from Auberdine. The Cenarion Circle sent the night elf druid to investigate its reach from Teldrassil and seek help from travelers and local allies.

Terenthis investigates Fel Moss and other corruption in Darkshore. The Cenarion Circle sent him to Auberdine to track the blight spreading from Teldrassil. Night elves fear it may shatter the balance of northern Kalimdor. Terenthis seeks the cause of the rot and ways to stop it before it consumes the forests.
